name: LED lighting retrofit — all plants
description: Replace T8 fluorescents with LED across Pune + Chennai plants. 35% energy saving on lighting circuit.
notes: Completed on schedule. CEA grid EF × MWh saved = 420 tCO2e/yr reduction.

name: Rooftop solar PPA — Pune Plant
description: 25-year PPA with SolarNova — 4.2 MWp rooftop. Zero capex model. ₹2.8/kWh vs ₹7.5 grid tariff.
notes: Financial close complete. Construction Q3 FY25.

name: Supplier ESG programme — Top 10 by spend
description: Engage top-10 suppliers (85% of Cat 1 spend). Require CDP disclosure + SBTi commitment by FY26.

name: Modal shift — road to rail (Bhilai→Pune)
description: Shift steel coil lane from HGV diesel to rail (CONCOR). 62% lower tCO2e/t·km on rail.
notes: CONCOR rates agreed. Lead time increases from 3 to 5 days.

name: Green hydrogen pilot — process heat
description: Replace natural gas with green H2 for furnace heat in Chennai plant. Pilot 500 kW electrolyser.
notes: Pre-FEED study underway. H2 cost still 3× NG. Long-term strategic bet.
